am.L: እናንተ ግን የተወደዳችሁ ሆይ፣ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሐዋርያት አስቀድመው የተናገሩትን ቃል አስታውሱ፤ \v 18 እንዲህ ይሏችሁ ነበርና፦ «በመጨረሻው ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ የገዛ ምኞታቸውን ተከትለው የሚሄዱ ዘባቾች ይኖራሉ።»
am.B: እናንተ ግን ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፣ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሐዋርያት አስቀድመው የተናገሩትን ቃል አስታውሱ። \v 18 እንዲህ ይሏችሁ ነበር፦ «በመጨረሻው ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን የማይፈራ የገዛ ምኞታቸው የሚነዳቸው ዘባቾች ይመጣሉ።»
am.R: እናንተ ግን ውድ ወዳጆቼ፣ የጌታችን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሐዋርያት ምን እንደሚሆን አስቀድመው የነገሯችሁን አስታውሱ። \v 18 እንዲህ ይሏችሁ ነበር፦ «በመጨረሻው ዘመን የሚያሾፉና የሚያላግጡ ሰዎች ይመጣሉ። እግዚአብሔርን የማያከብር የገዛ ምኞታቸውን ተከትለው ይኖራሉ።»

decisions.choice: one record: verse 18 says what the apostles' words were
alternatives: two records, divided at the raised dot after verse 17
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has a raised dot at the end of verse 17, but verse 18 begins with ὅτι, "that", which introduces the content of the words the readers are to remember. It cannot stand on its own as a sentence, so the two verses are one record, as 2 Peter 3:1-4 holds its parallel together.

decisions.choice: beloved: as in verse 3
decisions.reason: Jude turns from the false teachers to his readers, as he does again in verse 20.

decisions.choice: the apostles of our Lord: Jude speaks of them as others, whose words the readers had heard
decisions.reason: Jude does not count himself among the apostles. The readers had heard the apostles themselves: ἔλεγον, "they used to say", is an imperfect, which suggests a warning given more than once. Paul (Acts 20:29-30; 1 Timothy 4:1; 2 Timothy 3:1-5) and Peter (2 Peter 3:3) gave such warnings.

decisions.choice: a saying of the apostles also found in 2 Peter 3:3
decisions.reason: 2 Peter 3:3 has nearly the same words: in the last days scoffers will come, going according to their own desires. Jude says "the last time" and adds "of ungodliness"; 2 Peter adds "with scoffing" and goes on to the scoffers' question about the Lord's coming. Both present it as something the readers had been told by the apostles.

decisions.choice: the last time: the time before the Lord's return, which Jude's readers were already living in
decisions.reason: The New Testament speaks of the last days or the last hour as already begun (Acts 2:17; Hebrews 1:2; 1 John 2:18). Verse 19 says of the false teachers, "These are" the scoffers: the warning is coming true.

decisions.choice: their own desires of ungodliness: desires for what is ungodly
decisions.reason: ἀσεβειῶν is plural, "ungodlinesses", a genitive that describes the desires: they want ungodly things. It is the word repeated in verse 15.

decisions.choice: dear friends
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: people who laugh and sneer
decisions.reason: As in 2 Peter 3:3.

decisions.choice: a new sentence: They used to tell you
alternatives: that they used to say to you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new English sentence where the quotation is introduced; the meaning is the same (m1).

decisions.choice: el último tiempo; burladores (L, B); gente que se ríe y se burla (R)
decisions.reason: The saying is the one in 2 Peter 3:3, and Spanish uses the same words for the scoffers. But Jude says "the last time" where 2 Peter says "the last days" (m4), so Spanish keeps "el último tiempo" rather than matching 2 Peter.

decisions.choice: wakati wa mwisho; wadhihaki (L, B); watu wanaocheka na kudhihaki (R)
decisions.reason: The saying is the one in 2 Peter 3:3, and Swahili uses the same words for the scoffers. Jude says "the last time" where 2 Peter says "the last days" (m4), so Swahili keeps "wakati wa mwisho".

decisions.choice: "조롱하는 사람들" (L); "비웃는 사람들" (B); "비웃고 빈정대는 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: The same saying as 2 Peter 3:3 (meaning decision), with the same Korean at each level.

decisions.choice: ዘባቾች (scoffers, mockers, L, B); የሚያሾፉና የሚያላግጡ ሰዎች (people who laugh and sneer, R)
decisions.reason: The same saying of the apostles is in 2 Peter 3:3 (meaning decision m4); "ዘባች" is one who mocks and scorns, and the Amharic 2 Peter should keep the same word there.

source.text: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ ἀποδιορίζοντες, ψυχικοί, πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες.

records.literal_gloss: These are the [ones] causing divisions, natural [ones], spirit not having.

en.L: These are the ones who cause divisions, natural [people], not having [the] Spirit.
en.B: These people create divisions among you. They are worldly, and the Spirit is not in them.
en.R: These people split the church into groups. They think and act like the world around them, and they do not have God's Spirit.

es.L: Estos son los que causan divisiones, naturales, que no tienen [el] Espíritu.
es.B: Estas personas crean divisiones entre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Son mundanas, y el Espíritu no está en ellas.
es.R: Estas personas dividen a la iglesia en grupos. Piensan y actúan como el mundo que las rodea, y no tienen el Espíritu de Dios.

sw.L: Hawa ndio wale wanaosababisha mafarakano, [watu] wa asili ya kibinadamu tu, wasio na Roho.
sw.B: Watu hawa wanaleta mafarakano kati yenu. Ni watu wa kidunia, na Roho hayumo ndani yao.
sw.R: Watu hawa wanaligawa kanisa katika makundi. Wanafikiri na kutenda kama ulimwengu unaowazunguka, wala hawana Roho wa Mungu.

fr.L: Ce sont eux qui provoquent des divisions, [des gens] naturels, qui n’ont pas [l’]Esprit.
fr.B: Ces gens créent des divisions parmi vous. Ils sont attachés à ce monde, et l’Esprit n’est pas en eux.
fr.R: Ces gens divisent l’église en groupes. Ils pensent et agissent comme le monde qui les entoure, et ils n’ont pas l’Esprit de Dieu.

ko.L: 이 사람들은 분열을 일으키는 사람들이고, 본성대로 사는 사람들이며, 성령이 없는 사람들입니다.
ko.B: 이 사람들은 여러분 가운데 분열을 일으킵니다. 그들은 세상적인 사람들이고, 그들 안에는 성령이 계시지 않습니다.
ko.R: 이 사람들은 교회를 여러 무리로 갈라놓습니다. 그들은 주위의 세상 사람들처럼 생각하고 행동합니다. 그들에게는 하나님의 영이 없습니다.

vi.L: Những kẻ này là những kẻ gây chia rẽ, thuộc về con người tự nhiên, không có Thánh Linh.
vi.B: Những người này gây chia rẽ giữa anh chị em. Họ sống theo tinh thần thế gian, và Thánh Linh không ở trong họ.
vi.R: Những người này chia rẽ Hội Thánh thành từng nhóm. Họ suy nghĩ và hành động giống như thế gian chung quanh, và họ không có Thánh Linh của Đức Chúa Trời.

pt.L: Estes são os que causam divisões, [pessoas] naturais, não tendo [o] Espírito.
pt.B: Essas pessoas criam divisões entre vocês. São mundanas, e o Espírito não está nelas.
pt.R: Essas pessoas dividem a igreja em grupos. Pensam e agem como o mundo ao redor delas, e não têm o Espírito de Deus.

am.L: እነዚህ የሚለያዩ፣ ተፈጥሮአውያን፣ መንፈስ የሌላቸው ናቸው።
am.B: እነዚህ ሰዎች በመካከላችሁ መለያየትን ይፈጥራሉ። ተፈጥሮአዊ ሕይወት ብቻ ያላቸው ናቸው፤ መንፈስም በእነርሱ ውስጥ የለም።
am.R: እነዚህ ሰዎች ቤተ ክርስቲያንን ወደ ቡድኖች ይከፋፍላሉ። እንደ ዓለም ሰዎች ያስባሉ፤ እንደ እነርሱም ያደርጋሉ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ የላቸውም።

decisions.choice: causing divisions: splitting the church into groups
alternatives: making distinctions, ranking people as more or less spiritual
decisions.reason: ἀποδιορίζω is found only here in the Bible. It means to mark off or divide. Most likely they create factions; some take it of drawing lines between supposedly spiritual and unspiritual believers, a claim Jude turns back on them in the next words.

decisions.choice: natural: living on the level of ordinary human life, without the Spirit
decisions.reason: ψυχικοί describes the person who has only natural human life, the life of the soul. Paul sets the natural person, who does not accept the things of the Spirit, against the spiritual person (1 Corinthians 2:14-15; compare 15:44-46), and James 3:15 uses the word for wisdom that is earthly. If the false teachers claimed to be the truly spiritual ones, Jude says the opposite.

decisions.choice: not having the Spirit: the Holy Spirit is not in them
alternatives: not having a spirit, a spiritual nature
decisions.reason: πνεῦμα has no article, but the contrast with "praying in the Holy Spirit" in the next verse shows that the Spirit of God is meant (compare Romans 8:9).

decisions.choice: natural (L); worldly (B); think and act like the world around them (R)
decisions.reason: "Natural" alone sounds like praise in current English. Balanced and Readable say what Jude means: their life belongs to this world and not to the Spirit (m2).

decisions.choice: God's Spirit
decisions.reason: Readable says whose Spirit is meant (m3).

decisions.choice: [watu] wa asili ya kibinadamu tu
decisions.reason: ψυχικοί describes people who have only natural human life, without the Spirit (m2). "Wa kinafsi" would follow the Greek root ("nafsi") but today suggests selfishness. Literal says "of merely human nature"; Balanced and Readable follow the English in saying "worldly".

decisions.choice: naturels (L); attachés à ce monde (B); pensent et agissent comme le monde (R); l’église, lowercase (R)
decisions.reason: The word means living on the level of ordinary human life, without the Spirit (m2). French "psychique" now means "of the mind", and "charnel" belongs to another Greek word, so Literal says "naturels" and Balanced and Readable say what is meant. As in Colossians 4:15, the local congregation is "l’église".

decisions.choice: "본성대로 사는 사람들" (L); "세상적인 사람들" (B); "세상 사람들처럼" (R); "성령" for the Spirit
decisions.reason: The word means living on the level of ordinary human life, without the Spirit (meaning decision), the word rendered "본성의" in James 3:15. The Spirit they lack is the Holy Spirit (meaning decision), so Korean says "성령" (L, B) and "하나님의 영" (R).

decisions.choice: "thuộc về con người tự nhiên" (L) for natural
decisions.reason: The word is the one James 3:15 uses, life on the level of ordinary human nature without the Spirit (m2), so Literal uses the same Vietnamese words as the Vietnamese James; Balanced and Readable say worldly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ተፈጥሮአውያን (natural people, L); ተፈጥሮአዊ ሕይወት ብቻ ያላቸው (who have only natural life, B), as in the Amharic 1 Corinthians 2:14
decisions.reason: The word describes life on the level of ordinary human nature, without the Spirit (meaning decision m2). The Amharic 1 Corinthians uses "ተፈጥሮአዊ" for the same Greek word and keeps "ሥጋዊ" for a different one, so Jude follows it; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὑμεῖς δέ, ἀγαπητοί, ἐποικοδομοῦντες ἑαυτοὺς τῇ ἁγιωτάτῃ ὑμῶν πίστει, ἐν πνεύματι ἁγίῳ προσευχόμενοι, ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἀγάπῃ θεοῦ τηρήσατε προσδεχόμενοι τὸ ἔλεος τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.

records.literal_gloss: You but, beloved, building up yourselves on the most holy of you faith, in [the] Spirit Holy praying, \v 21 yourselves in [the] love of God keep, awaiting the mercy of the Lord of us Jesus Christ to life eternal.

en.L: But you, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in [the] Holy Spirit, \v 21 keep yourselves in [the] love of God, awaiting the mercy of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} to eternal life.
en.B: But you, dear friends, keep building yourselves up on your most holy faith and praying in the Holy Spirit. \v 21 Keep yourselves within God's love, while you look forward to the mercy of our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} that brings eternal life.
en.R: But you, dear friends, keep building your lives on your most holy faith. Pray as the Holy Spirit leads you and helps you. \v 21 Keep yourselves living in God's love. And look forward to the day when our Lord Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} will show you mercy and give you eternal life.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi, wapendwa, mkijijenga wenyewe juu ya imani yenu takatifu mno, mkisali ndani ya Roho Mtakatifu, \v 21 jilindeni wenyewe ndani ya upendo wa Mungu, mkitazamia rehema ya Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ielekeayo uzima wa milele.
sw.B: Lakini ninyi, wapendwa, endeleeni kujijenga juu ya imani yenu iliyo takatifu kabisa, na kuomba katika Roho Mtakatifu. \v 21 Jilindeni ndani ya upendo wa Mungu, huku mkiitazamia rehema ya Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} inayoleta uzima wa milele.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi, wapendwa wangu, endeleeni kujenga maisha yenu juu ya imani yenu iliyo takatifu kabisa. Ombeni kama Roho Mtakatifu anavyowaongoza na kuwasaidia. \v 21 Jilindeni ili mzidi kuishi katika upendo wa Mungu. Tena itazamieni siku ambayo Bwana wetu Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} atawaonyesha rehema na kuwapa uzima wa milele.

fr.L: Mais vous, bien-aimés, vous édifiant vous-mêmes sur votre très sainte foi, priant dans l’Esprit Saint, \v 21 gardez-vous vous-mêmes dans l’amour de Dieu, attendant la miséricorde de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} pour la vie éternelle.
fr.B: Mais vous, mes chers amis, continuez à vous construire sur votre très sainte foi et à prier dans l’Esprit Saint. \v 21 Gardez-vous dans l’amour de Dieu, en attendant la miséricorde de notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, qui conduit à la vie éternelle.
fr.R: Mais vous, mes chers amis, continuez à bâtir votre vie sur votre très sainte foi. Priez comme l’Esprit Saint vous conduit et vous aide. \v 21 Gardez-vous dans l’amour de Dieu. Et attendez avec impatience le jour où notre Seigneur Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} vous montrera {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} miséricorde et vous donnera la vie éternelle.

ko.L: 그러나 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분의 지극히 거룩한 믿음 위에 자신을 세우며, 성령 안에서 기도하면서, \v 21 하나님의 사랑 안에 자신을 지키고, 영원한 생명에 이르게 하는 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 긍휼을 기다리십시오.
ko.B: 그러나 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분의 지극히 거룩한 믿음 위에 자신을 계속 세워 가고, 성령 안에서 기도하십시오. \v 21 하나님의 사랑 안에 자신을 지키고, 영원한 생명으로 이끄는 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 긍휼을 기다리십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 사랑하는 여러분, 여러분의 지극히 거룩한 믿음 위에 여러분의 삶을 계속 세워 가십시오. 성령께서 이끄시고 도우시는 대로 기도하십시오. \v 21 하나님의 사랑 안에 머물며 살도록 자신을 지키십시오. 그리고 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}께서 여러분에게 긍휼을 베푸시고 영원한 생명을 주실 그날을 기다리십시오.

vi.L: Nhưng hỡi những người yêu dấu, anh chị em hãy gây dựng mình trên đức tin rất thánh của mình, cầu nguyện trong Đức Thánh Linh, \v 21 hãy giữ mình trong tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời, trông đợi lòng thương xót của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} cho đến sự sống đời đời.
vi.B: Nhưng thưa anh chị em yêu dấu, hãy tiếp tục gây dựng mình trên đức tin rất thánh của mình và cầu nguyện trong Đức Thánh Linh. \v 21 Hãy giữ mình trong tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời, trong khi trông đợi lòng thương xót của Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} đem lại sự sống đời đời.
vi.R: Nhưng anh chị em thân mến, hãy tiếp tục xây dựng đời sống mình trên đức tin rất thánh của mình. Hãy cầu nguyện theo sự dẫn dắt và giúp đỡ của Đức Thánh Linh. \v 21 Hãy giữ mình luôn sống trong tình yêu thương của Đức Chúa Trời. Và hãy trông đợi ngày Chúa chúng ta là Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}} tỏ lòng thương xót anh chị em và ban cho anh chị em sự sống đời đời.

pt.L: Mas vocês, amados, edificando-se sobre a fé santíssima de vocês, orando no Espírito Santo, \v 21 guardem-se no amor de Deus, aguardando a misericórdia do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} para a vida eterna.
pt.B: Mas vocês, queridos amigos, continuem se edificando sobre a fé santíssima de vocês e orando no Espírito Santo. \v 21 Mantenham-se no amor de Deus, enquanto aguardam a misericórdia do nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, que traz a vida eterna.
pt.R: Mas vocês, queridos amigos, continuem construindo a vida sobre a fé santíssima de vocês. Orem como o Espírito Santo guia e ajuda vocês. \v 21 Continuem vivendo no amor de Deus. E esperem com alegria o dia em que o nosso Senhor Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} vai mostrar misericórdia a vocês e dar a vocês a vida eterna.

am.L: እናንተ ግን የተወደዳችሁ ሆይ፣ እጅግ ቅዱስ በሆነው እምነታችሁ ላይ ራሳችሁን እየገነባችሁ፣ በመንፈስ ቅዱስ እየጸለያችሁ፣ \v 21 የዘላለም ሕይወትን ለማግኘት የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ምሕረት እየጠበቃችሁ ራሳችሁን በእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ጠብቁ።
am.B: እናንተ ግን ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፣ እጅግ ቅዱስ በሆነው እምነታችሁ ላይ ራሳችሁን መገንባታችሁንና በመንፈስ ቅዱስ መጸለያችሁን ቀጥሉ። \v 21 የዘላለም ሕይወትን የሚያስገኘውን የጌታችንን የኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ምሕረት በናፍቆት እየጠበቃችሁ ራሳችሁን በእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር ውስጥ ጠብቁ።
am.R: እናንተ ግን ውድ ወዳጆቼ፣ እጅግ ቅዱስ በሆነው እምነታችሁ ላይ ሕይወታችሁን መገንባታችሁን ቀጥሉ። መንፈስ ቅዱስ በሚመራችሁና በሚረዳችሁ መሠረት ጸልዩ። \v 21 በእግዚአብሔር ፍቅር መኖራችሁን ቀጥሉ። ጌታችን ኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ምሕረቱን የሚያሳያችሁንና የዘላለም ሕይወትን የሚሰጣችሁን ቀን በናፍቆት ጠብቁ።

decisions.choice: one command, keep yourselves in God's love, with three participles that say how
decisions.reason: The only imperative is τηρήσατε, "keep". Building, praying and waiting describe how they are to do it, and they carry the force of commands too. Faith, the Holy Spirit, the love of God and the mercy of Jesus Christ: Jude's call names Father, Son and Spirit together.

decisions.choice: building yourselves up on your most holy faith: growing on the foundation of the faith handed on to you
decisions.reason: ἐποικοδομέω means to build on a foundation (1 Corinthians 3:10-14; Ephesians 2:20; Colossians 2:7). The faith here is what is believed, "handed over once for all" (verse 3), and it is most holy because it comes from God. "Yourselves" is plural: they build up one another as well as themselves.

decisions.choice: praying in the Holy Spirit: prayer led and empowered by the Spirit
decisions.reason: The Spirit helps believers pray (Romans 8:26-27; Ephesians 6:18). The words stand against verse 19: the false teachers do not have the Spirit, and the readers pray in him.

decisions.choice: the love of God: God's love for them, in which they are to remain
decisions.reason: ἀγάπῃ θεοῦ could mean God's love or love for God. Verse 1 calls them loved in God the Father, and the command is to keep themselves in that love, as Jesus said, "remain in my love" (John 15:9-10). So it most likely means God's love for them. Those who are kept (verse 1) are told to keep themselves: both are true.

decisions.choice: awaiting the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ that leads to eternal life: looking for the mercy he will show at his coming
decisions.reason: προσδέχομαι is eager expectation (Luke 2:25; Titus 2:13). The mercy is what Christ will show his people on the day of judgment (compare 2 Timothy 1:18), and its result is eternal life. "To eternal life" most likely goes with "mercy": mercy that brings them into eternal life.

decisions.choice: dear friends
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: the participles as commands: keep building, pray, look forward
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the participles the force of commands, which they have here (m1).

decisions.choice: look forward to the day when our Lord Jesus Christ will show you mercy
alternatives: waiting for the mercy of our Lord
decisions.reason: Readable says when the mercy is shown, at the Lord's coming (m5).

decisions.choice: Pray as the Holy Spirit leads you and helps you
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in the Holy Spirit" (m3).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:guárdense|guardaos}} (L, B); {{plural_you:manténganse|manteneos}} viviendo (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep "guardar", the verb of verses 1, 6 and 13: those whom God keeps are told to keep themselves (m4). Readable says "manténganse", as the English Readable says "keep yourselves living".

decisions.choice: one command, "지키고" ... "기다리십시오" (L), with the participles kept as clauses ("세우며", "기도하면서")
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads one command, keep yourselves in God's love, with three participles that say how. Literal keeps them as clauses leading to the command; Balanced and Readable give several commands, as the English does.

decisions.choice: one command, ጠብቁ (keep), at the end, with the three participles before it (L)
decisions.reason: The Greek has one command with three participles that say how it is done (meaning decision m1). Amharic is verb-final, so Literal puts the three converbs first and the command "ራሳችሁን ... ጠብቁ" last, all within verse 21 for the command and verse 20 for the first two participles; Balanced and Readable make separate commands, as the English does.

source.text: καὶ οὓς μὲν ἐλεᾶτε διακρινομένους, οὓς δὲ σῴζετε ἐκ πυρὸς ἁρπάζοντες, οὓς δὲ ἐλεᾶτε ἐν φόβῳ, μισοῦντες καὶ τὸν ἀπὸ τῆς σαρκὸς ἐσπιλωμένον χιτῶνα.

records.literal_gloss: And some on one hand have mercy on, doubting [ones], \v 23 others but save out of fire snatching, others but have mercy on with fear, hating even the by the flesh having been stained tunic.

en.L: And have mercy on some who doubt; \v 23 and save others, snatching [them] out of fire; and on others have mercy with fear, hating even the tunic stained by the flesh.
en.B: Be merciful to some who are wavering. \v 23 Save others by pulling them out of the fire. To still others show mercy, but with fear: hate even the clothes their sinful flesh has soiled.
en.R: Show mercy to people who have doubts. \v 23 Pull others out of the fire and save them. Show mercy to still others, but do it with fear. Hate even the clothes that their sinful lives have made dirty.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} misericordia de algunos que dudan; \v 23 y a otros {{plural_you:sálvenlos|salvadlos}}, arrebatándolos del fuego; y de otros {{plural_you:tengan|tened}} misericordia con temor, aborreciendo incluso la túnica manchada por la carne.

A otros más, {{plural_you:muéstrenles|mostradles}} misericordia, pero con temor: {{plural_you:aborrezcan|aborreced}} hasta la ropa manchada por su carne pecadora.
es.R: {{plural_you:Muestren|Mostrad}} misericordia a los que tienen dudas. \v 23 A otros, {{plural_you:sáquenlos|sacadlos}} del fuego y {{plural_you:sálvenlos|salvadlos}}. A otros más, {{plural_you:muéstrenles|mostradles}} misericordia, pero {{plural_you:háganlo|hacedlo}} con temor. {{plural_you:Odien|Odiad}} incluso la ropa ensuciada por la vida de pecado de esa gente.

sw.L: Na wengine wahurumieni, walio na shaka; \v 23 na wengine waokoeni, mkiwanyakua kutoka motoni; na wengine wahurumieni kwa hofu, mkichukia hata kanzu iliyotiwa madoa na mwili.
sw.B: Wahurumieni wengine walio na mashaka. \v 23 Waokoeni wengine kwa kuwanyakua kutoka motoni. Na wengine wahurumieni, lakini kwa hofu: chukieni hata nguo zilizochafuliwa na mwili wao wenye dhambi.
sw.R: Waonyesheni rehema watu walio na mashaka. \v 23 Wanyakueni wengine kutoka motoni na kuwaokoa. Waonyesheni wengine rehema, lakini fanyeni hivyo kwa hofu. Chukieni hata nguo ambazo maisha yao ya dhambi yamezichafua.

fr.L: Et faites miséricorde aux uns, qui doutent ; \v 23 sauvez-en d’autres en [les] arrachant au feu ; et aux autres faites miséricorde avec crainte, haïssant même la tunique souillée par la chair.
fr.B: Soyez miséricordieux envers certains qui hésitent. \v 23 Sauvez-en d’autres en les arrachant au feu. Et à d’autres encore, montrez de la miséricorde, mais avec crainte : haïssez même les vêtements que leur chair pécheresse a salis.
fr.R: Montrez de la miséricorde à ceux qui ont des doutes. \v 23 Arrachez d’autres au feu pour les sauver. Montrez de la miséricorde à d’autres encore, mais faites-le avec crainte. Détestez même les vêtements que leur vie pécheresse a salis.

ko.L: 그리고 의심하는 어떤 사람들은 불쌍히 여기십시오. \v 23 어떤 사람들은 불에서 끌어내어 구원하십시오. 또 어떤 사람들은 두려움으로 불쌍히 여기되, 육체로 더럽혀진 속옷까지도 미워하십시오.
ko.B: 흔들리는 사람들을 불쌍히 여기십시오. \v 23 또 다른 사람들은 불에서 끌어내어 구원하십시오. 또 다른 사람들에게는 긍휼을 베풀되, 두려운 마음으로 하십시오. 그들의 죄악된 육체로 더럽혀진 옷까지도 미워하십시오.
ko.R: 의심하는 사람들에게 긍휼을 베푸십시오. \v 23 어떤 사람들은 불에서 끌어내어 구원하십시오. 또 어떤 사람들에게는 긍휼을 베풀되, 두려워하는 마음으로 하십시오. 그들의 죄악된 삶으로 더러워진 옷까지도 미워하십시오.

vi.L: Và hãy thương xót một số người đang hoài nghi; \v 23 hãy cứu những người khác, giật [họ] ra khỏi lửa; và với những người khác nữa, hãy thương xót với lòng kính sợ, ghét cả cái áo bị xác thịt làm ô uế.
vi.B: Hãy thương xót những người đang phân vân. \v 23 Hãy cứu những người khác bằng cách kéo họ ra khỏi lửa. Với những người khác nữa, hãy tỏ lòng thương xót nhưng phải kính sợ: hãy ghét cả quần áo đã bị xác thịt tội lỗi của họ làm ô uế.
vi.R: Hãy tỏ lòng thương xót những người đang nghi ngờ. \v 23 Hãy kéo những người khác ra khỏi lửa và cứu họ. Hãy tỏ lòng thương xót những người khác nữa, nhưng hãy làm điều đó với lòng kính sợ. Hãy ghét cả quần áo đã bị đời sống tội lỗi của họ làm dơ bẩn.

pt.L: E de alguns, que duvidam, tenham misericórdia; \v 23 e a outros salvem, arrebatando-[os] do fogo; e de outros tenham misericórdia com temor, odiando até a túnica manchada pela carne.
pt.B: Sejam misericordiosos com alguns que estão vacilando. \v 23 Salvem outros, tirando-os do fogo. E a outros ainda mostrem misericórdia, mas com temor: odeiem até as roupas que a carne pecadora deles manchou.
pt.R: Mostrem misericórdia às pessoas que têm dúvidas. \v 23 Salvem outros, puxando-os para fora do fogo. Mostrem misericórdia a outros ainda, mas façam isso com temor. Odeiem até as roupas que a vida de pecado deles sujou.

am.L: የሚጠራጠሩትን አንዳንዶቹን ማሩ፤ \v 23 ሌሎችን ከእሳት ነጥቃችሁ አድኑ፤ ሌሎችንም በሥጋ የረከሰውን እጀ ጠባብ እንኳ እየጠላችሁ በፍርሃት ማሩ።
am.B: ለሚጠራጠሩት ለአንዳንዶቹ ምሕረት አድርጉ። \v 23 ሌሎችን ከእሳት ነጥቃችሁ አድኑ። ለሌሎች ደግሞ በፍርሃት ምሕረት አድርጉ፤ በኃጢአተኛ ሥጋቸው የቆሸሸውን ልብስ እንኳ ጥሉ።
am.R: ለሚጠራጠሩ ሰዎች ምሕረት አሳዩ። \v 23 ሌሎችን ከእሳት ጎትታችሁ አውጥታችሁ አድኑ። ለሌሎች ደግሞ ምሕረት አሳዩ፤ ነገር ግን በፍርሃት አድርጉት። በኃጢአተኛ ሕይወታቸው የቆሸሸውን ልብሳቸውን እንኳ ጥሉ።

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: three groups: have mercy on some who doubt; save others, snatching them out of fire; have mercy on others with fear
alternatives: two groups, in a shorter text
"rebuke" or "convict" some who dispute, in place of the first "have mercy"
"have compassion on some, making a difference" (the reading the King James Version follows)
decisions.reason: These two verses are among the hardest in the New Testament to establish. The manuscripts differ in the number of groups (two or three), in the verbs (have mercy, rebuke or convict, save, snatch) and in their order. The SBLGNT prints a three-part text, with the verb ἐλεᾶτε, "have mercy", in the first and third parts and "save ... snatching" in the second. Some important manuscripts read "rebuke" or "convict" in the first part instead of "have mercy"; some, among them the early papyrus P72 and Codex Vaticanus, have a shorter text with only two groups; and the text behind the King James Version reads "have compassion on some, making a difference". In every form the readers are told to reach out to those in danger, some gently and some urgently, without sharing their sin. Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: who doubt: wavering, unsure, under the false teachers' influence
alternatives: who dispute, who argue with you
decisions.reason: διακρίνω in the middle voice can mean to doubt or waver (Matthew 21:21; James 1:6) or to dispute, as Michael disputed with the devil in verse 9. Here these people are to receive mercy, which fits those who are wavering better than those who argue.

decisions.choice: snatching them out of fire: rescuing people at the edge of judgment
decisions.reason: Amos 4:11 and Zechariah 3:2 speak of a burning stick snatched from the fire, someone rescued just in time; Zechariah 3:2 is also the verse Jude quotes in verse 9. The fire is the judgment of verse 7.

decisions.choice: with fear: with reverence toward God, and on guard against being drawn into their sin
decisions.reason: The fear is not fear of the people themselves. It is the awe of God that takes sin seriously, and the care of someone who knows that sin spreads (Galatians 6:1).

decisions.choice: hating even the tunic stained by the flesh: keep clear of every trace of their sin
decisions.reason: χιτῶνα is the tunic worn next to the skin. In Zechariah 3:3-4 Joshua the high priest stands in filthy garments, which are taken away as a sign that his guilt is removed; it is the scene Jude has already drawn on in verse 9 and in "snatching them out of fire". ἐσπιλωμένον, "stained", is related to the word for a stain in 2 Peter 2:13. "The flesh" is human nature as sin uses it (verses 7-8). Mercy goes out to the person; hatred is for the sin, even for what has touched it.

decisions.choice: tunic (L); clothes (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal names the garment; Balanced and Readable use the ordinary word, since the point is what the clothing has touched (m5).

decisions.choice: their sinful flesh (B); their sinful lives (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say whose flesh, and in what sense (m5).

decisions.choice: who doubt (L); who are wavering (B); who have doubts (R)
decisions.reason: All three render the sense chosen in m2.

decisions.choice: kanzu (L); nguo (B, R)
decisions.reason: χιτῶνα is the tunic worn next to the skin (m5). "Kanzu" is the long garment worn next to the body, and the word older Swahili uses for the tunic; Balanced and Readable say "nguo" (clothes), as the English says "clothes".

decisions.choice: faites miséricorde (L); soyez miséricordieux, montrez de la miséricorde (B, R)
decisions.reason: The verb is from the same word as "miséricorde" in verses 2 and 21; French keeps the family visible. "Avoir pitié" can sound condescending in current French.

decisions.choice: "불쌍히 여기다" (L), "긍휼을 베풀다" (B, R) for have mercy; "의심하는" (L, R), "흔들리는" (B) for those who doubt; "두려움으로"
decisions.reason: The meaning decision follows the SBLGNT's three groups, with "those who doubt" as wavering under the false teachers' influence, both footnoted. "긍휼" links with the mercy of the Lord in verse 21, as the Greek does; Literal uses the verb form "불쌍히 여기다".

decisions.choice: "육체로 더럽혀진 속옷" (L); "죄악된 육체로 더럽혀진 옷" (B)
decisions.reason: The tunic stained by the flesh is a picture for every trace of their sin (meaning decision). "육체" keeps the picture of the body that soils the garment, as in verse 7; Balanced adds "죄악된", as the English Balanced adds "sinful".

decisions.choice: "cái áo" (L); "quần áo" (B, R) for the tunic
decisions.reason: The Greek word is the tunic worn next to the skin; Literal says "cái áo", and Balanced and Readable "quần áo", as the English says "clothes". The picture is of keeping clear of every trace of their sin (m5).

source.text: Τῷ δὲ δυναμένῳ φυλάξαι ὑμᾶς ἀπταίστους καὶ στῆσαι κατενώπιον τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ ἀμώμους ἐν ἀγαλλιάσει μόνῳ θεῷ σωτῆρι ἡμῶν διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν δόξα μεγαλωσύνη κράτος καὶ ἐξουσία πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ νῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς αἰῶνας· ἀμήν.

records.literal_gloss: To the [one] now being able to guard you without stumbling and to make stand before the glory of him blameless with exultation, \v 25 to only God Savior of us through Jesus Christ the Lord of us, glory, majesty, might and authority, before all the age and now and into all the ages; amen.

en.L: Now to the one who is able to guard you from stumbling and to make [you] stand before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory without blemish, in exultation, \v 25 to God alone, our Savior, through Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} our Lord, [be] glory, majesty, might, and authority, before all the age, and now, and into all the ages. Amen.
en.B: Now to the one who is able to guard you from stumbling, and to bring you into the presence of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory without blemish and rejoicing greatly, \v 25 to God alone, our Savior, through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Lord, be glory, majesty, might, and authority, before time began, now, and for all the ages to come. Amen.
en.R: God is able to guard you, so that you do not stumble and fall. He can bring you into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glorious presence without any fault, and you will be filled with gladness. \v 25 He is the only God, our Savior. Through Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} our Lord, may glory, greatness, power, and authority be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}}, before time began, now, and forever! Amen.

es.L: Y al que puede proteger{{plural_you:los|os}} sin tropiezo y hacer{{plural_you:los|os}} estar en pie delante de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria sin mancha, con gran alegría, \v 25 al único Dios, nuestro Salvador, por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor, [sea] gloria, majestad, poder y autoridad, antes de todo el siglo, y ahora, y por todos los siglos. Amén.
es.B: Y al que puede proteger{{plural_you:los|os}} para que no {{plural_you:tropiecen|tropecéis}}, y llevar{{plural_you:los|os}} a la presencia de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria sin mancha y llenos de alegría, \v 25 al único Dios, nuestro Salvador, por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor, sea la gloria, la majestad, el poder y la autoridad, desde antes de que comenzara el tiempo, ahora y por todos los siglos venideros. Amén.
es.R: Dios puede proteger{{plural_you:los|os}} para que no {{plural_you:tropiecen|tropecéis}} ni {{plural_you:caigan|caigáis}}. Él puede llevar{{plural_you:los|os}} ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia gloriosa sin ninguna falta, y {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} {{plural_you:estarán|estaréis}} llenos de alegría. \v 25 Él es el único Dios, nuestro Salvador. Por medio de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías,}} nuestro Señor, que la gloria, la grandeza, el poder y la autoridad sean {{deity_pronoun:suyos|Suyos}}, desde antes de que comenzara el tiempo, ahora y para siempre. Amén.

sw.L: Basi, kwa yule anayeweza kuwahifadhi bila kujikwaa, na kuwasimamisha bila dosari mbele ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa shangwe, \v 25 kwa Mungu pekee, Mwokozi wetu, kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu, [kuwe na] utukufu, adhama, nguvu na mamlaka, kabla ya nyakati zote, na sasa, na hata katika nyakati zote. Amina.
sw.B: Basi, kwa yule anayeweza kuwahifadhi msianguke, na kuwaleta mbele ya utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} bila dosari na kwa shangwe kuu, \v 25 kwa Mungu pekee, Mwokozi wetu, kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu, kuwe na utukufu, adhama, nguvu na mamlaka, tangu kabla ya mwanzo wa wakati, sasa, na milele yote. Amina.
sw.R: Mungu anaweza kuwahifadhi ili msijikwae na kuanguka. Anaweza kuwaleta mbele ya uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wenye utukufu bila kosa lolote, nanyi mtajawa na furaha. \v 25 Yeye ndiye Mungu pekee, Mwokozi wetu. Kupitia Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} Bwana wetu, utukufu, ukuu, nguvu na mamlaka viwe {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}}, tangu kabla ya mwanzo wa wakati, sasa, na milele! Amina.

fr.L: Or à celui qui peut vous préserver de toute chute et vous faire tenir debout devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, sans tache, dans l’allégresse, \v 25 au seul Dieu, notre Sauveur, par Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} notre Seigneur, [soient] gloire, majesté, force et autorité, avant tout âge, et maintenant, et dans tous les âges. Amen.
fr.B: À celui qui peut vous préserver de toute chute et vous faire paraître devant {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire sans tache et dans une grande joie, \v 25 au seul Dieu, notre Sauveur, par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} notre Seigneur, soient la gloire, la majesté, la force et l’autorité, avant le commencement des temps, maintenant et pour tous les siècles à venir. Amen.
fr.R: Dieu peut vous protéger pour que vous ne trébuchiez pas et ne tombiez pas. Il peut vous faire entrer dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence glorieuse sans aucun défaut, et vous serez remplis de joie. \v 25 Il est le seul Dieu, notre Sauveur. Par Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} notre Seigneur, que la gloire, la grandeur, la puissance et l’autorité soient à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, avant le commencement des temps, maintenant et pour toujours ! Amen.

ko.L: 여러분을 지켜 넘어지지 않게 하시고, 그분의 영광 앞에 흠 없이 기쁨으로 서게 하실 수 있는 분, \v 25 곧 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여 우리의 구주이신 유일하신 하나님께, 영광과 위엄과 권능과 권세가 영원 전부터, 그리고 지금, 그리고 영원토록 [있기를 빕니다]. 아멘.
ko.B: 여러분을 지켜 넘어지지 않게 하시고, 그분의 영광 앞에 흠 없이 큰 기쁨으로 서게 하실 수 있는 분, \v 25 곧 우리의 구주이신 유일하신 하나님께, 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해 영광과 위엄과 권능과 권세가 영원 전부터, 지금도, 그리고 영원토록 있기를 빕니다. 아멘.
ko.R: 하나님께서는 여러분을 지키셔서 넘어지지 않게 하실 수 있습니다. 그분은 여러분을 아무 흠 없이 그분의 영광스러운 앞에 서게 하실 수 있고, 여러분은 기쁨으로 가득할 것입니다. \v 25 그분은 오직 한 분이신 하나님, 우리의 구주이십니다. 우리 주 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통해, 영광과 위대하심과 능력과 권세가 영원 전부터, 지금도, 그리고 영원토록 그분께 있기를 빕니다! 아멘.

vi.L: Nguyện Đấng có thể gìn giữ anh chị em khỏi vấp ngã và khiến [anh chị em] đứng trước vinh quang {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không tì vết, trong sự vui mừng, \v 25 là Đức Chúa Trời duy nhất, Cứu Chúa chúng ta, qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta, [được] vinh quang, uy nghiêm, quyền năng và thẩm quyền, từ trước mọi thời đại, bây giờ, và cho đến mọi thời đại. A-men.
vi.B: Nguyện Đấng có quyền gìn giữ anh chị em khỏi vấp ngã, và đem anh chị em vào trước mặt vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không tì vết và đầy vui mừng, \v 25 là Đức Chúa Trời duy nhất, Cứu Chúa chúng ta, qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta, được vinh quang, uy nghiêm, quyền năng và thẩm quyền, từ trước khi có thời gian, bây giờ, và cho đến muôn đời. A-men.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời có quyền năng gìn giữ anh chị em, để anh chị em không vấp ngã. Ngài có thể đem anh chị em vào trước sự hiện diện vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà không có lỗi gì, và anh chị em sẽ tràn đầy vui mừng. \v 25 Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời duy nhất, là Cứu Chúa của chúng ta. Qua Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, Chúa chúng ta, nguyện vinh quang, sự cao cả, quyền năng và thẩm quyền thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, từ trước khi có thời gian, bây giờ, và cho đến đời đời! A-men.

pt.L: Ora, àquele que pode proteger vocês para que não tropecem e fazê-[los] ficar de pé diante da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, sem defeito, em exultação, \v 25 ao único Deus, nosso Salvador, por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}}, nosso Senhor, [sejam] glória, majestade, poder e autoridade, antes de toda a era, e agora, e por todas as eras. Amém.
pt.B: Àquele que é capaz de proteger vocês para que não tropecem e de levá-los à presença da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória sem defeito e cheios de alegria, \v 25 ao único Deus, nosso Salvador, por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, nosso Senhor, sejam a glória, a majestade, o poder e a autoridade, desde antes do começo dos tempos, agora e por todas as eras que virão. Amém.
pt.R: Deus é capaz de proteger vocês, para que não tropecem nem caiam. Ele pode levar vocês à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença gloriosa sem nenhum defeito, e vocês vão ficar cheios de alegria. \v 25 Ele é o único Deus, o nosso Salvador. Por meio de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, nosso Senhor, que a glória, a grandeza, o poder e a autoridade sejam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, desde antes do começo dos tempos, agora e para sempre! Amém.

am.L: ከመሰናከል ሊጠብቃችሁና በክብሩ ፊት ያለ ነውር በታላቅ ደስታ ሊያቆማችሁ ለሚችለው፣ \v 25 በጌታችን በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} በኩል አዳኛችን ለሆነው ለብቻው አምላክ፣ ክብር፣ ግርማ፣ ኃይልና ሥልጣን ከዘመናት ሁሉ በፊት፣ አሁንም፣ እስከ ዘላለምም [ይሁን]። አሜን።

decisions.choice: one record: the doxology and its closing Amen
decisions.reason: The SBLGNT has a raised dot before ἀμήν, "Amen". The Amen cannot stand alone: it is the closing response to the doxology, as in 2 Peter 3:18, and the record keeps it with the doxology.

decisions.choice: a doxology: glory is ascribed to God, and the verb is understood
decisions.reason: There is no verb. In such words of praise the sense is a wish or an acclamation: may glory be his, or glory is his (Romans 16:25-27; 2 Peter 3:18). The opening lines describe God by what he is able to do.

decisions.choice: without stumbling, without blemish: kept from falling, and presented faultless
decisions.reason: ἀπταίστους means not stumbling: not falling into sin or away from the faith, the opposite of what has happened to the false teachers. ἀμώμους is the word for a sacrifice without defect (1 Peter 1:19) and for the people God presents to himself (Ephesians 1:4; Colossians 1:22). The verb for guarding, φυλάσσω, is not the "keep" of verses 1 and 21 but a word for guarding or protecting.

decisions.choice: to make you stand before his glory: to bring you into God's presence on the last day
decisions.reason: κατενώπιον means in the very presence of. God's glory stands for God himself in his splendor; to stand before it is to be welcomed on the day of judgment, not condemned. ἀγαλλιάσει is exultant joy, the gladness of a festival.

decisions.choice: the only God our Savior: God himself is Savior, and he saves through Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Calling God "Savior" is common in the Old Testament (Isaiah 43:3, 11; 45:21) and in the New (Luke 1:47; 1 Timothy 1:1; Titus 1:3). "Only" confesses that there is one God (Deuteronomy 6:4). Verse 4 used "only" of Jesus Christ as Master; Jude sets the two side by side without explaining how they relate.

decisions.choice: through Jesus Christ our Lord: most likely with the praise: glory is given to God through Christ
alternatives: with "Savior": God saves through Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: The phrase stands between "our Savior" and the list of praises. Elsewhere glory is given to God through Jesus Christ (Romans 16:27; 1 Peter 4:11), and that is the most likely sense here; it can also be read with "Savior", and both are true.

decisions.choice: glory, majesty, might, authority: God's splendor, greatness, power and right to rule
decisions.reason: Glory (δόξα) is God's honor and splendor; majesty (μεγαλωσύνη) is his greatness (Hebrews 1:3; 8:1); might (κράτος) is his ruling power; authority (ἐξουσία) is his right to rule.

decisions.choice: before all the age, and now, and into all the ages: for all time, past, present and future
decisions.reason: πρὸ παντὸς τοῦ αἰῶνος means before all time. Jude's doxology reaches back before creation as well as forward without end.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "the only God", with "through Jesus Christ our Lord" and "before all time"
alternatives: "the only wise God" (the reading the King James Version follows)
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "wise" after "only" (compare Romans 16:27) and leave out "through Jesus Christ our Lord" and "before all time"; the King James Version follows that text. The SBLGNT follows the earlier manuscripts, which have the longer phrases and lack "wise". Reviewers must check this against the SBLGNT apparatus.

decisions.choice: guard
decisions.reason: "Keep" is kept for the verb of verses 1, 6, 13 and 21; this is a different verb (m3).

decisions.choice: God alone (L, B); the only God (R)
decisions.reason: "To God alone" and "the only God" say the same: there is no other God (m5).

decisions.choice: God is able
decisions.reason: Readable names God at once, as verse 25 does.

decisions.choice: before time began, now, and for all the ages to come (B); before time began, now, and forever (R)
alternatives: before all the age, and now, and into all the ages
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say the same span of time in current English (m8).

decisions.choice: you will be filled with gladness
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly whose joy is meant: the joy of those God brings before him (m4).

decisions.choice: proteger
decisions.reason: φυλάξαι is a different verb from the "keep" (τηρέω) of verses 1, 6, 13 and 21 (English r-en-1). Spanish keeps "guardar" for that verb and says "proteger" here.

decisions.choice: kuwahifadhi
decisions.reason: φυλάξαι is a different verb from the "keep" of verses 1, 6, 13 and 21, which Swahili renders "kulinda". So Swahili says "kuhifadhi" (to guard, preserve) here.

decisions.choice: kuwe na utukufu, adhama, nguvu na mamlaka (L, B); utukufu, ukuu, nguvu na mamlaka viwe vyake (R)
decisions.reason: The doxology has no verb (m2). Swahili says "kuwe na" (may there be) before a list of four nouns of different classes, and Readable makes them agree together with "viwe vyake". "Adhama" is majesty; Readable says "ukuu" (greatness), as the English Readable does. "Utukufu" is glory, as in 2 Peter 3:18.

decisions.choice: préserver (L, B); protéger (R)
decisions.reason: As in English: "garder" is kept for the verb of verses 1, 6, 13 and 21, and this is a different verb (m3).

decisions.choice: "있기를 빕니다" (a doxology as a prayer of praise); "유일하신 하나님 ... 구주이신"; "예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}를 통하여" placed with the praise (B, R)
decisions.reason: The doxology ascribes glory to God with the verb understood (meaning decision); Korean must supply one, and "있기를 빕니다" is the current form of the prayer (archaic "-을지어다" is avoided). The meaning decision reads "through Jesus Christ our Lord" as going with the praise, which Balanced and Readable show by its place; Literal keeps the Greek order.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời duy nhất, Cứu Chúa chúng ta" at every level
decisions.reason: God himself is Savior, and he saves through Jesus Christ (m5). "Cứu Chúa" is the Protestant word for Savior, used for Christ in 2 Peter and here for God, as the Greek does.

decisions.choice: proteger
decisions.reason: "Guardar" is kept for the verb of verses 1, 6, 13 and 21; this is a different verb (m3), as the English distinguishes "guard" from "keep". "Proteger" is the plain word for keeping someone safe from harm.

decisions.choice: ao único Deus
decisions.reason: "Ao único Deus" says that there is no other God (m5) in the order Portuguese uses for a doxology; the English "God alone" and "the only God" say the same (r-en-2).

decisions.choice: ለብቻው አምላክ / ብቸኛ አምላክ (the only God); አዳኛችን (our Savior), as in 1 John 4:14 and 2 Peter; ክብር፣ ግርማ፣ ኃይልና ሥልጣን (glory, majesty, might and authority); ይሁን (be) supplied at Literal; አሜን
decisions.reason: In a doxology the verb is understood (meaning decision m2); Literal brackets "ይሁን" and Balanced and Readable say it. "አምላክ" is used where God is described as the only God (m5), as in John 17:3. The four words name God's splendour, greatness, power and right to rule (m7).
